paragraphs.source_en: Matsudaira Shigeyoshi leapt down from his horse. “So it was you. Is the young lord well?”

units.source_en: Matsudaira Shigeyoshi leapt down from his horse.
“So it was you.
Is the young lord well?”

paragraphs.source_zh: 松平重吉跳下马背。“原来是你。少主还好吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “He is well.” As Shigemasa spoke, he concealed the severed head at his waist.

units.source_en: “He is well.”
As Shigemasa spoke, he concealed the severed head at his waist.
units.source_zh: 重政边说边将腰间的头颅藏了起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: “很好。”重政边说边将腰间的头颅藏了起来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Excellent. A messenger has come from Hamamatsu. The young lord is to take the field for the first time. How is Hiraiwa Chikayoshi?”

units.source_en: “Excellent.
A messenger has come from Hamamatsu. The young lord is to take the field for the first time.
units.source_zh: 滨松来了使者，少主要初征了。

units.source_en: How is Hiraiwa Chikayoshi?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “太好了。滨松来了使者，少主要初征了。平岩亲吉怎样？”

paragraphs.source_en: “He remains wholly devoted to his lord.”

units.source_en: “He remains wholly devoted to his lord.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Excellent. Chikayoshi must go to Hamamatsu at once. Honda Sakuza will come to take his place.”

units.source_en: “Excellent.
Chikayoshi must go to Hamamatsu at once. Honda Sakuza will come to take his place.”
units.source_zh: 亲吉必须立刻去滨松，本多作左来代替他。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “太好了。亲吉必须立刻去滨松，本多作左来代替他。”

units.source_en: “Will there be a great battle?”

paragraphs.source_en: “I shall report to the young lord at once.”

units.source_en: “I shall report to the young lord at once.”
“Please do.”

paragraphs.source_en: Shigemasa watched Shigeyoshi depart, then immediately made his way to Nobuyasu’s private quarters.

units.source_en: Shigemasa watched Shigeyoshi depart, then immediately made his way to Nobuyasu’s private quarters.
units.source_zh: 重政目送着重吉远去，立刻向信康的内庭走去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 重政目送着重吉远去，立刻向信康的内庭走去。

paragraphs.source_en: Nobuyasu was in Ayame’s room; he had not yet killed the young attendant. For his mother’s honor, the girl had to die! Though he had resolved to do it, he could find no ready pretext for taking her life.

units.source_en: Nobuyasu was in Ayame’s room; he had not yet killed the young attendant.
units.source_zh: 信康正在菖蒲房中，他还没有杀小侍从。

units.source_en: For his mother’s honor, the girl had to die!

ja.t: るためには、どうしても

units.source_zh: 为了母亲的声誉，必须杀掉她！

units.source_en: Though he had resolved to do it, he could find no ready pretext for taking her life.
units.source_zh: 他虽然已下了决心，却轻易找不到杀人的借口。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信康正在菖蒲房中，他还没有杀小侍从。为了母亲的声誉，必须杀掉她！他虽然已下了决心，却轻易找不到杀人的借口。

paragraphs.source_en: “Well?” Nobuyasu asked, then suddenly noticed Jianjing’s head at Shigemasa’s waist. “Come with me.” He rose and left Ayame’s room, not wishing her to see it.

units.source_en: “Well?”
Nobuyasu asked, then suddenly noticed Jianjing’s head at Shigemasa’s waist.
units.source_zh: 信康问道，忽然看到重政腰间减敬的头颅。

units.source_en: “Come with me.”
He rose and left Ayame’s room, not wishing her to see it.

ja.t: せたくなかったのである。

units.source_zh: 他起身离开菖蒲的房间，他不想让菖蒲看到。

paragraphs.source_zh: “如何？”信康问道，忽然看到重政腰间减敬的头颅。“跟我来。”他起身离开菖蒲的房间，他不想让菖蒲看到。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, please come into the courtyard. Jianjing’s head is about to become an offering for your first campaign...”

units.source_en: “My lord, please come into the courtyard.
Jianjing’s head is about to become an offering for your first campaign...”
units.source_zh: 减敬的首级马上就要成为少主初征的祭品……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “少主，请到院里来。减敬的首级马上就要成为少主初征的祭品……”

units.source_en: “What? My first campaign...”

paragraphs.source_en: “Matsudaira Shigeyoshi of Nomi has already brought the order. He has entered the castle.” Only after saying this did Shigemasa begin to consider where Jianjing’s head should be buried.

units.source_en: “Matsudaira Shigeyoshi of Nomi has already brought the order. He has entered the castle.”
units.source_zh: “能见的松平重吉已经带来命令，他入城了。”

units.source_en: Only after saying this did Shigemasa begin to consider where Jianjing’s head should be buried.
units.source_zh: 说完，重政方才开始思量将减敬的首级葬在何处。

paragraphs.source_zh: “能见的松平重吉已经带来命令，他入城了。”说完，重政方才开始思量将减敬的首级葬在何处。
